headline: NVIDIA Guides Q4 Revenue to $130 Billion and Gross Margin to 72%
summary: NVIDIA expects fourth-quarter revenue of $130 billion, plus or minus 3%, with gross margins expected to range between 71% and 72%.
why: As a dominant player in artificial intelligence hardware, Nvidia's forward guidance serves as a crucial benchmark for the technology sector and broader market sentiment.

impacts.name: NVIDIA
impacts.why: Strong quarterly revenue and margin projections signal robust demand for AI infrastructure.
